Online payments with cash

Pay bills, top up an account, or buy online. All with cash at a retailer near you.

  • Quick and easy

    Choose cash at checkout, get a slip, and pay at a nearby agent.

  • Safe and secure

    No card or bank login needed, so your financial details stay with you.

  • Open for long hours

    Many payment points stay open early and late, close to where you live.

This is how it works

  1. 1

    Open your app

    Choose “Cash” as the way to add money.

  2. 2

    Enter an amount

    Get your slip by SMS, email, or print it.

  3. 3

    Pay the agent

    Show the slip, hand over the cash, keep the receipt.

Frequently asked questions

What is OhentPayCash?+

A way to pay for online things with cash. You get a slip, then pay an agent in person.

How do I get a slip?+

Choose OhentPayCash as your payment method. The slip appears on screen and can be sent by SMS or email, or printed.

What if the barcode won’t scan?+

Give the agent the 12-digit code printed under the barcode. They can enter it by hand.

How long is my slip valid?+

Each slip shows its expiry date. Pay before it runs out, or get a new slip.
